data.one_liner: Widget that enables simultaneous vertical and horizontal scrolling with always‑visible custom scrollbars.
data.what_it_does: CrossScroll wraps any child and adds independent scrollbars for both axes. It also offers custom thumb/track styling and a beta infinite scrolling mode.
use_when: You need a single widget to scroll content in both directions at once
You want always‑visible scrollbars or custom scrollbar appearance
avoid_when: You require a fully stable, production‑ready solution (the package is still in beta)
You need advanced scrolling physics beyond what the widget exposes
strengths: Beta infinite scrolling and diagonal movement
weaknesses: Package is in early beta and may have undiscovered bugs
